tei:titleStmt.tei:title: יוצר לשבת לפני שבעות
Yotser piyyuṭ for the Shabbat before Shavuot by Rabbi Binyamin bar Zeraḥ

tei:div.tei:head: Yotser piyyuṭ for the Shabbat before Shavuot by Rabbi Binyamin bar Zeraḥ

tei:lg.tei:l: Blessed are You,
Cause, our God,
Sovereign of the Universe,
Maker of light and Creator of darkness,
Maker of peace and Creator of all.
Eternal light in life’s storehouses,
lights from tenebrosity They said, and it was.
As I praise with clashing cymbals the Deity, God, the Cause,
I will explain to my myriad people the letters of Their Torah
that They wondrously, greatly bequeathed to Moses on Sinai.
Alef
Atop the alphabet, the first, but read with three,
alluding to the unified Name, sanctified with three holinesses;
this is the interpretation of the first and its three letters.
Bet
Between two are its meanings and place, which lets us know
that the world is destined to be destroyed in floods twice,
once in the Deluge era, and once in the year 6093.
Gimel
Grace They granted upon Their world,
affirming souls and life and counsel from with Them,
and the other needs of Their works who trust in Their name.
Holy!
Dalet
Does its form open towards hei for a reason?
All who succeed in this world will be impoverished in the next —
such as Esau and its fellows, who do great evil.
Hei
...has a pronunciation different from all other letters.
They all require a place of articulation but such is not found for hei,
teaching you that in hei the generations of the globe and heights were created.
Waw
Waiting before the Deity of deities are the hooks of the fire-pillars,
which are the Explicated Names, highest of all names;
the lion-angels make use of their secret mysteries.
Zayin
Zeal of the sixteen keys this is,
including the womb, rain, and the graves of dead spirits,
and last of all, the key of the pit-leeches.
Ḥet
Checkered ones of Israel, sinners — for sin [ḥeṭ] is its interpretation —
will in the future do repentance to testify none is like the Deity
and then they will be considered like the other righteous of Israel.
Ṭet
Turf of the world to come, from which the pious will grow,
sects and groups, honored and praised,
and the scent of their clothes like sweet-smelling offerings.
Yod
Yes, a monument and name, and a crown of splendor
will be made to adorn Their treasure in evidence and tradition —
an eternal name I will give them that will not be cut off.
Kaf
Keeping up support, the Deity makes the nation of nations rejoice
in the inheritance of three hundred and ten universes,
and the pleasure of the ziz sadai, leviathan, and behemoth.
Lamed
Let the human heart be weighed like all the organs —
eye and ear and speech and all the other things —
for upon it hangs the awe of the One who lowers and raises.
Mem
Meaning? A parable of two dwelling in one dwelling,
for in the Throne of Glory they praise and bow down to arrange;
Your sovereignty is a sovereignty of all universes; Your rule is in all generations!
Nun
Not the soul of a beast is the Cause’s light, but the human soul;
although their death is similar one to another,
at the resurrection of the dead the human spirit rises.
Samekh
Secret of the Tabernacle, upon which the pact hangs:
the camp of Judah eastwards, and the camp of Reuben southwards,
and the camp of Ephraim westwards, and the camp of Dan northwards.
‘Ayin
Of those who do it, it is a tree of life, like the auricle of the ear,
Testifying upon the eye, and deciding justice in scales;
The Cause’s commandment is pure, enlightening the eyes.
Pe
...pertains to the heavy of mouth and heavy of tongue,
who cried, “Give me rhetoric, for for this the tongue was made!”
They responded, “Who gave a mouth to the human primeval?”
Tsadi
It’s the righteousness our God has with flesh and blood,
teaching them the righteous path and much good intending for them;
to make Their mighty wonders known to humanity.
Qof
Quasaric beams of the skin of the face of the Freer encircling every wise matter;
Whose word is like flame going out and Whose face is like the glow of the sun,
to lighten the heavy burden from upon the pure dove.
Resh
Reckoned are the first-fruits of the children of the three patriarchs
to every nation as head and not as tails,
dwelling first in sovereignty, the Rider of Clouds.
Shin
She has three branches, like a birthstool,
for thrice the teeth of the wicked will shatter,
and to Their people profit in skill and might will strengthen.
Thaw
Though human cravings crave for many things,
wealth and greatness and honor and dug pits,
in death, only Torah and good deeds accompany you.
By these, the One who chose and formed all Their work with them
enrooted the globe for Their footstool and the welkin for Their seat
jazzing up the moon and sun and the constellations of Their sovereignty.
Measuring-days gone and since, They set the side of the universe,
imbuing and filling all the earth’s corners and voids,
near work’s end, resting and ceasing from all labors.
Gimel
Grace They granted upon Their world,
affirming souls and life and counsel from with Them,
and the other needs of Their works who trust in Their name.
Holy!

As a glottal consonant, /h/ has no place of articulation other than the glottis. But /h/ is unique in that it often doesn’t have a point of articulation in the glottis either. This means that it is unique from all other consonants, more like a vowel in some ways, and very difficult for phoneticians to classify.

The keys of rain, birth, and resurrection of the dead are mentioned in Taanit 2a as three matters that God deals with directly rather than entrusting an angel to them. The idea that there are sixteen is, to my knowledge, not found anywhere prior to this poem, but Ḥazal is a big field so I may have missed it. Perhaps it is related to the idea that God’s sword has sixteen faces (Midrash Tehillim 78:16)
